ground_truth.title: Mesh Style Chairs
ground_truth.main_content:
The ergonomic mesh office chairs in this category include designs with mesh backs and padded seats, as well as all-mesh task chairs. Before choosing your ergonomic mesh office chair, consider the benefits of a padded seat versus a full-mesh seat. While the full-mesh seat is highly popular, many users prefer a little seat padding in their task chairs in place of an all-mesh seat foundation. Not sure if an all-mesh or a mesh-back office chair with lumbar support is right for you? Contact us by Live Chat or direct at 888-355-4999.
